test.name: Full research objective hands off the workflow
test.description: The user gives a research objective and expects the orchestrator to drive the full GPS workflow — question selection through proof conclusion. This is research's core trigger: a broad objective the user wants handed off rather than driven step by step.
test.xfail_reason: research and project-status both match a 'drive the workflow forward on an existing project' request, so the orchestrator is bypassed and `activated` is False; the downstream routing is still correct. Measured 3/3 with activated=False on 2026-09-26. Pre-existing on main, not introduced by the continuous-work change. Remove this marker when #2927 narrows project-status's description and the test activates research 3/3.

input.user_message: Research the parents of Patrick Flynn, born about 1845 in Ireland. I want to identify both his father and mother from primary records.

judge_context: Should invoke sub-skills (question-selection, research-plan, search-records, etc.) rather than doing GPS work inline
Should read research.json state to determine the current routing step
